STAGE.Qualidade.pequena: small — blurry on a large screen
STAGE.Qualidade.Corta: crops {pct}% to fill — drag the background to choose the part
STAGE.Gestos.Fundo: On stage: drag the background to choose what shows · wheel zooms · double-click resets.
STAGE.Gestos.Personagem: Drag moves (feet snap to others' floor) · wheel: size · click: focus · right-click: flip · drag below the edge: remove. Hovering: arrows, + −, F, Delete.
STAGE.Aura.Dica: Light coming from the edges. A character with their own aura lights it up when focused.
